title: Infrastructure / VPS privilege topology and root recovery path — verification of 2026-08-20

observations.statement: TEST (operator session, 2026-08-20): the ubuntu account on the VPS has no sudo. This supersedes the earlier recorded single grant (root NOPASSWD /usr/local/sbin/mythos-logs, MOS-1.6) and the 'current state' table of docs/MYTHOS_SUDO_RESTRICTION_PROPOSAL.md, which is now historical.
TEST (operator session, 2026-08-20): ubuntu cannot su to deploy — no password path and no sudo path. Consistent with the MOS-1.6/MOS-1.7 boundary investigation recorded in oth-knowledge PROBLEMS.md.
TEST (operator session, 2026-08-20): direct root SSH to the VPS is disabled.
TEST (operator session, 2026-08-20): the OVH KVM console (via OVH Manager) provides root access to the VPS, and root can su - deploy. This is the verified root recovery path.

facts.statement: VERIFIED FACT: as of 2026-08-20 the ubuntu account on the production VPS has no sudo and cannot escalate to deploy by any path.
VERIFIED FACT: direct root SSH to the production VPS is disabled; root is reachable only through the OVH KVM console.

VERIFIED FACT: the root recovery path to the deploy account is: OVH Manager -> KVM console -> log in as root -> su - deploy -> work in /home/deploy/projects/mythos-prod. The non-emergency channel remains owner-machine SSH as deploy (see infrastructure-2026-08-19).
VERIFIED FACT: the deploy account owns /home/deploy/projects/mythos-prod, the production checkout of othoth77/mythos-prod on the VPS.
